## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable j2lint by adding `PYTHON_J2LINT` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable j2lint by adding `PYTHON_J2LINT` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

| Variable                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default value                  |
|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| PYTHON_J2LINT_ARGUMENTS                   | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                                            |                                |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS    | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                |                                |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE        | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)`                                                                                                                                                                  | Exclude no file                |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE        | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)`                                                                                                                                                            | Exclude no file                |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_CLI_LINT_MODE               | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `list_of_files`: Call the linter with the list of files as argument                                                                                                            | `list_of_files`                |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_FILE_EXTENSIONS             | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]`                                                                             | `[".j2", ".jinja", ".jinja2"]` |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_FILE_NAMES_REGEX            | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]`                        | Include every file             |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_PRE_COMMANDS                | List of bash commands to run before the linter                                                                                                                                                                      | None                           |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_POST_COMMANDS               | List of bash commands to run after the linter                                                                                                                                                                       | None                           |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES     | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling PYTHON_J2LINT and its pre/post commands                                                                                                                | None                           |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_DISABLE_ERRORS              | Run linter but consider errors as warnings                                                                                                                                                                          | `false`                        |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN | Maximum number of errors allowed                                                                                                                                                                                    | `0`                            |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS             | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout | `300`                          |
| PYTHON_J2LINT_CLI_EXECUTABLE              | Override CLI executable                                                                                                                                                                                             | `['j2lint']`                   |

## Use this plugin

Add the descriptor URL of the plugin to `PLUGINS` in `.mega-linter.yml`. MegaLinter installs the plugin when it starts, whatever the flavor:

```yaml
PLUGINS:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wesley-dean/mega-linter-plugin-j2lint/main/mega-linter-plugin-j2lint/j2lint.megalinter-descriptor.yml
```

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- File extensions: `.j2`, `.jinja`, `.jinja2`

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

- j2lint is called once with the list of files as arguments (`list_of_files` CLI lint mode)

### Example calls

```shell
j2lint **/*.j2
```


### Installation in Docker

MegaLinter runs these commands when it loads the plugin (only `RUN` instructions):

```dockerfile
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir j2lint==1.2.0
```

### Installation without Docker (native mode)

> **Native mode does not run plugins yet**: this section shows what the plugin declares for native mode.

Not available: see the MegaLinter checks of the plugin.

## MegaLinter checks

These results last changed on 2026-11-28, and MegaLinter checks the plugins every day. The checks only look at the descriptor of the plugin: they do not review the plugin, nor the tool it runs.

| Check        | Result                                  |
|:-------------|:----------------------------------------|
| Descriptor   | ⚠️ Incomplete                           |
| Native mode  | ❌ Not supported                        |
| SARIF output | ❌                                      |
| Native lock  | ⚠️ No lock shipped by the plugin author |

### Required

Missing required items:

- **`native_install` declared and valid for the 5 native platforms** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`): Native mode (MegaLinter without Docker) can not install the linter. Declare `native_install`, listing each of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 in `platforms` or in `unsupported` (with a reason)
- **SARIF output** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`): The findings are missing from SARIF reports (GitHub code scanning, SARIF viewers, coding agents). Set `can_output_sarif: true` with `cli_sarif_args` when the tool outputs SARIF, otherwise `sarif_text_regex` (one finding per line of text) or `sarif_unified_diff: true` (formatters printing a diff)

### Recommended

Missing recommended items:

- **Native lock shipped next to the descriptor (`<name>.megalinter-native-lock.json`), for verified native installs**
- **Configuration documentation URL (`linter_rules_configuration_url`)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)
- **Ignore file documentation URL (`linter_rules_ignore_config_url`)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)
- **SPDX license (`linter_spdx_license`)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)
- **Speed (`linter_speed`, 1 to 5)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)
- **IDE extensions (`ide`)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)
- **Default configuration file (`config_file_name`)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)
- **Test fixtures (`test_folder`)** (`PYTHON_J2LINT`)

### Plugin authors

The requirements and how to fix them are described in [Create your own plugin](../plugins.md#create-your-own-plugin).
